verdict.rationale: The Agent Server exposes API endpoints for runs, threads, and assistants (core execution/persistence primitives also visible in LangGraph Studio), suggesting reasonable API/UI parity, but there is no explicit documentation stating that all UI (e.g., Studio) capabilities are mirrored in the API, and a community comment notes streaming/persistence client implementations are left incomplete for developers to build themselves. Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API parity statement, independent confirmation that Studio-only features (e.g., visual debugging, time travel UI) are fully API-accessible.
